text: CREWS–PNG is an initiative under the global Climate Risk and Early Warning Systems (CREWS) international initiative, aimed at strengthening hydrometeorological services and impact-based early warning systems in Papua New Guinea. It focuses on building an end-to-end early warning system for drought, improving observational networks, and enhancing forecasting and service delivery for climate-sensitive sectors.

metadata.solution_name: CREWS–Papua New Guinea: Weather and Climate Early Warning System (CREWS–PNG)
